sub_graphs.title: Altair: Sync Committee Signature Validation and Rewards
sub_graphs.description: Models how sync committee members sign block roots, how signatures are aggregated and validated, and how rewards are distributed

nodes.label: SyncAggregate Received in Block
nodes.description: A block containing a SyncAggregate (512 participation bits + aggregated BLS signature) has been received

nodes.label: Resolve Current Sync Committee
nodes.description: Determine the current sync committee of 512 validators for this slot

nodes.label: Aggregate Participant Public Keys
nodes.description: Aggregate BLS public keys of participating sync committee members. Optimization: if all participated, use precomputed aggregate; if >50%, subtract non-participants; otherwise aggregate participants directly

nodes.label: Verify BLS Fast Aggregate Signature
nodes.description: Verify the aggregated BLS signature over the previous slot's block root using DOMAIN_SYNC_COMMITTEE

nodes.label: Sync Aggregate Valid
nodes.description: The sync committee signature has been verified successfully

nodes.label: Distribute Sync Committee Rewards
nodes.description: Reward participating members (SYNC_COMMITTEE_WEIGHT=2/64 of total rewards / 512 / 32 per slot) and penalize non-participants equally

nodes.label: Reward Proposer for Sync Aggregate
nodes.description: Proposer receives additional reward proportional to PROPOSER_WEIGHT / (WEIGHT_DENOMINATOR - PROPOSER_WEIGHT)

nodes.label: Sync Committee Rewards Applied
nodes.description: All sync committee rewards and penalties have been applied to validator balances

external_entities.name: Sync Committee Members
external_entities.description: 512 validators selected to sign block roots for light client support

sub_graphs.title: Altair: Attestation Processing with Participation Flags
sub_graphs.description: Models how attestations are processed using the new participation flag system with timeliness checks

nodes.label: Attestation Received
nodes.description: An attestation has been received for processing during block processing

nodes.label: Check Source Timeliness
nodes.description: Verify attestation inclusion delay is within integer_squareroot(SLOTS_PER_EPOCH) for TIMELY_SOURCE_FLAG

nodes.label: Check Target Timeliness
nodes.description: Verify attestation inclusion delay is within SLOTS_PER_EPOCH for TIMELY_TARGET_FLAG

nodes.label: Check Head Timeliness
nodes.description: Verify attestation was included in the immediately next slot for TIMELY_HEAD_FLAG

nodes.label: Update Participation Flags
nodes.description: Set TIMELY_SOURCE, TIMELY_TARGET, TIMELY_HEAD flags in epoch_participation for each attesting validator

nodes.label: Calculate Proposer Attestation Reward
nodes.description: Reward proposer proportionally to newly-set flag weights and attesting validator base rewards

nodes.label: Attestation Processed
nodes.description: Attestation flags updated and proposer rewarded

external_entities.name: Attesting Validators
external_entities.description: Validators submitting attestations with source, target, and head votes

sub_graphs.title: Altair: Inactivity Score Tracking and Penalty Calculation
sub_graphs.description: Models the inactivity leak mechanism including per-validator score tracking and quadratic penalty application

nodes.label: Epoch Boundary Reached
nodes.description: System has reached an epoch boundary, triggering epoch processing

nodes.label: Update Inactivity Scores
nodes.description: For each validator: if missed target, increment score by INACTIVITY_SCORE_BIAS (4); if not leaking, decrease by min(1, score); always decrease by min(INACTIVITY_SCORE_RECOVERY_RATE=16, score)

nodes.label: Inactivity Scores Updated
nodes.description: All validator inactivity scores have been adjusted for this epoch

nodes.label: Compute Flag-Based Rewards and Penalties
nodes.description: Calculate rewards per participation flag (source weight=14, target=26, head=14 out of 64) and penalties for non-participation

nodes.label: Compute Inactivity Penalties
nodes.description: For non-target participants: penalty = effective_balance * inactivity_score / (INACTIVITY_SCORE_BIAS * INACTIVITY_PENALTY_QUOTIENT=50331648)

nodes.label: Apply Rewards and Penalties to Balances
nodes.description: Apply calculated reward deltas and penalty deltas to each validator's balance

nodes.label: Validator Balances Updated
nodes.description: All validator balances reflect this epoch's rewards and penalties

sub_graphs.title: Altair: Sync Committee Selection and Rotation
sub_graphs.description: Models how sync committees are selected using RANDAO and rotated every 256 epochs

nodes.label: Sync Committee Period Boundary
nodes.description: The system has reached an epoch that is a multiple of EPOCHS_PER_SYNC_COMMITTEE_PERIOD (256)

nodes.label: Compute Next Sync Committee Indices
nodes.description: Probabilistically select 512 validators weighted by effective balance using RANDAO seed from EPOCHS_PER_SYNC_COMMITTEE_PERIOD + 1 epochs ago

nodes.label: Build SyncCommittee Object
nodes.description: Construct SyncCommittee with 512 public keys and precomputed aggregate public key

nodes.label: Rotate Sync Committees
nodes.description: Move next_sync_committee to current_sync_committee and assign newly computed committee as next

nodes.label: Sync Committees Rotated
nodes.description: Current and next sync committees updated in beacon state

ambiguities.text: The sync committee key aggregation uses three different strategies based on participation rate (all, >50%, ≤50%) but does not specify exact threshold handling when exactly 50% participate.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume '>50%' means strictly greater than 256 out of 512 participants for the subtraction optimization path.

ambiguities.text: The specification states inactivity scores decrease by 'min(1, score)' during non-leak periods but also by 'min(INACTIVITY_SCORE_RECOVERY_RATE, score)'. The interaction between these two decrements is not obvious.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume both decrements are applied sequentially: first subtract min(1, score) if not leaking, then always subtract min(16, score). This results in up to 17 points decrease per epoch.

ambiguities.text: No explicit handling is specified for the case where a sync committee member is slashed between committee selection and their duty period.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume slashed validators still appear in the committee but their signatures are not counted for rewards. They receive penalties for non-participation.

implicit_assumptions.description: The RANDAO seed used for sync committee selection is assumed to be sufficiently unpredictable that an attacker cannot bias committee composition.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: An attacker could manipulate RANDAO to place colluding validators on sync committees, enabling false light client updates.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker controlling fewer than 2/3 of sync committee members cannot produce a valid aggregate signature over a false block root.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Light clients could be deceived into following an invalid chain.

implicit_assumptions.description: Validators will honestly participate in sync committees because the economic incentives (rewards for participation, penalties for non-participation) are sufficient motivation.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Low sync committee participation could weaken light client security and reduce confidence in finality proofs.
